Job Description
Role Overview:
We are looking for a Staff Engineer to lead the long-term technical vision and architecture of our AI platform supporting GTM systems. This role will drive scalability, reliability, and governance of AI-driven systems while ensuring alignment with business goals.
Key Responsibilities:
Own architecture and long-term system health of the AI platform
Design scalable data pipelines and real-time intelligence systems
Establish AI governance, observability, and performance standards
Provide technical leadership and mentor engineering teams
Define and maintain data integrity through Golden Record strategy
Proactively identify and mitigate system risks
Requirements:
6 8+ years of experience in software engineering
Strong experience in system architecture and scalable platforms
Expertise in Python, AWS, PostgreSQL, and event-driven systems
Strong focus on reliability, observability, and engineering excellence
Experience leading teams and driving architectural decisions
Nice to Have:
Experience building AI/ML platforms
Background in GTM systems, CRM, or revenue technology
Experience in data governance and AI evaluation frameworks
